title: 5 Halloween Weekend Plans in South Florida
igCaption:
Five Halloween weekend plans.
Oct. 24-27, South Florida, free and up

Sources: Gulf Coast News and Weather, Miami New Times, Secret Miami, WSVN, Sun Sentinel

#Miami #FortLauderdale #SouthFlorida #Halloween

scenes.text: Need Halloween weekend plans that are cheap and specific to South Florida?
Number five: Everglades and other Florida national parks waive fees Tuesday for Theodore Roosevelt's birthday.
scenes.caption: Number 5: Everglades and other Florida national parks waive fees Tuesday for Theodore Roosevelt's birthday.

scenes.text: Number four: Family Fest 2026 is Sunday at the ICA Miami Expansion Space on Northeast 41st Street. Adults are fifty dollars, kids are fifteen dollars, and children under three get in free.
scenes.caption: Number 4: Family Fest 2026 is Sunday at the ICA Miami Expansion Space on NE 41st St. Adults are $50, kids are $15, and children under 3 get in free.

scenes.text: Number three: Scene Queen plays Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale on Saturday at seven. Tickets cost thirty-nine dollars and fifty cents, with Wargasm and Bailey Spinn opening the Metalicious Tour. If you’re at Revolution Live, open NEAR and see who else was there.
scenes.caption: Number 3: Scene Queen plays Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale on Saturday at 7. Tickets cost $39.50, with Wargasm and Bailey Spinn opening the Metalicious Tour. If you’re at Revolution Live, open NEAR and see who else was there.

scenes.text: Number two: Brightline runs one Midnight Train for Halloween Horror Nights riders. It leaves Orlando at 12:15 a.m. Sunday and stops in West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Fort Lauderdale, Aventura, and Miami.

scenes.text: And number one: House of Horror is marking 25 years with a new venue, themed nights, and 5 haunted houses.

scenes.text: Which one would you do this weekend? Halloween weekends are full of people you cross paths with once and never ask about, and NEAR shows you who that stranger in costume actually was.
